title: She Sells Seashells | Gulf Front Seagrove Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: She Sells Seashells is a pet-friendly, one-level Gulf-front home in Seagrove with panoramic views, private beach access, bikes, and easy rides to Seaside.
description_expanded: She Sells Seashells Gulf Front One Level Home with Panoramic Views in Seagrove Home Introduction Welcome to She Sells Seashells , a comfortable one level Gulf front retreat with panoramic water views and direct private beach access. Just a quick bike ride from Seaside and steps from dining, this pet friendly home offers easy coastal living with comfort, convenience, and unbeatable scenery. Home Highlights - Gulf front location with panoramic unobstructed Gulf views - All one level with no stairs to enter or inside the home - Access to 4 Taxi bikes regularly serviced - Two minute bike ride to Seaside food trucks and shopping - Located across from Surfing Deer and two minutes to Publix and local dining - Pet friendly for up to 2 dogs 60 pounds or less with approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee - Renovated private sundeck with gated stairs to the beach - Outdoor living with dining for 6 Gulf facing loungers outdoor shower and gas grill - Smart TVs throughout the home - Whole home WIFI and cable - Dining table seating for 6 kitchen table seating for 6 and breakfast bar seating for 2 - Full kitchen with extra ice maker - Driveway parking for 4 vehicles garage access not available Location Perks - Easy walk or bike to Seaside shops restaurants and food trucks - Across from Surfing Deer - Two minutes to Publix The Perfect Pig and Pizza by the Sea - Direct Gulf front location with no need to cross 30A Know Before You Go - Pets are not allowed on the beach per county regulations - Mid stay clean required for stays 10 days or longer, and the cost is included in your reservation - Garage access not available - Concierge services available including LSV rental, baby equipment rentals, grocery delivery, and more ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: King Suite 1 | Gulf Views, Walk-in Closet and dresser storage, Ensuite Bath with walk-in shower, TV
King Guest Room 2 | Gulf views, hallway access to shared Full Bath with combination shower/tub and side entrance to back patio, dresser storage, TV
King Guest Room 3 | Adjacent to shared Full Bath with combination shower/tub and side entrance to back patio, reach in closet and dresser storage, TV
Bunk Suite | Two Double over Double Bunks (Sleeps 4), Ensuite Bath with combination shower/tub and side entrance to back patio, Seating Area with TV and oversized bean bag chairs, dresser storage
Bonus | Two Twin EZ Beds - elevated air beds. Recommended for the bunk room but can be used in any room of the home

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
